_mode_comment: pir = PIR-triggered operation; continuous = continuous detection.

model._path_comment: Hailo HEF model file used for inference.
model._labels_comment: Text file containing one class name per line, in the same order as the HEF class IDs.
model._confidence_comment: Minimum detection confidence. Detections below this value are ignored.

camera._width_comment: Main camera output width in pixels.
camera._height_comment: Main camera output height in pixels.
camera._fps_comment: Requested camera FPS. It is clamped between fps_min and fps_max.

pir._gpio_pin_comment: GPIO pin connected to the PIR sensor.
pir._cooldown_comment: Minimum time between two PIR-triggered events.
pir._capture_comment: Set image and/or video to true to choose what is captured.

video._trigger_comment: detected = start video only when a trigger class is detected; always = start video on every PIR trigger.

continuous._cooldown_comment: Minimum time between two continuous capture events.
continuous._capture_comment: Set image and/or video to true to choose what is captured.

video._comment: Global video recording settings shared by PIR and continuous modes.
video._fps_comment: Video recording FPS. The value is clamped between camera.fps_min and camera.fps_max.
video._codec_comment: OpenCV four-character video codec used for saved video files.

overlay._comment: Information drawn onto the live preview and saved media.
overlay._show_fps_comment: Show the current FPS in the top-left corner.
overlay._show_datetime_comment: Show the Raspberry Pi system date and time in the top-left corner.
overlay._show_class_name_comment: Show the detected class name next to each bounding box.
overlay._show_confidence_comment: Show the detection confidence next to each class name.
overlay._background_comment: Draw a coloured background behind detection labels.

detection._trigger_classes_comment: Only these classes can trigger capture events. Other detected classes can still have boxes displayed.
detection._box_colors_comment: Per-class bounding-box colours in #RRGGBB format. Classes without a custom colour use default_box_color.
detection._default_box_color_comment: Bounding-box colour used for any class not listed in box_colors.

output._directory_comment: Root directory where captured images and videos are stored.

preview._enabled_comment: Show the live camera preview window.
preview._window_name_comment: Title of the live preview window.
